''See also: [[Doctor Nova Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Doctor Nova, also known as [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five]], is a [[Aether Technician|Master Aether Technician]] and the inventor of the [[Divine Titans]]. She is recognized by her signature creation, [[Nova-Bots]], which typically feature a single red light on their visors. While she has been classified as a wanted fugitive, she was previously held in unlawful captivity before being freed by [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]]. Her professional attire consists of an elaborate white coat with blue edges, a visor, and various [[Aethertech]] [[console|consoles]] and tools attached to her arms and belt. Beyond her work with [[Titans]], she is the creator of the android [[Starhammer]], though she has expressed concerns regarding his malfunctioning and violent behavior. Her expertise includes research into genetic engineering and various technical fields, though she notes her abilities do not extend to biological modification.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Known for a capacity to deceive, this individual was once a legendary criminal alongside [[Spellbinder]]. They have been targeted by others and were previously held in custody by [[the Advocates]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Doctor Nova is a persona used by [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five|Mell]], who also identifies her as their voice. She was once the partner of the narrator in an alternate life and worked alongside [[Spellbinder]] as a legendary criminal. Additionally, she is the creator of [[Starhammer]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|As an [[Aether Technician]], they possess specialized technical knowledge. They are also an [[Archmage of sealing and binding]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Legendary criminal era}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Doctor Nova was present for the initial activation of [[Starhammer]]'s [[Evolution Engine]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c40">''The Engineer'', chapter 40</ref> Serving as [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five|Mell]]'s voice, she is an [[Archmage]] specializing in sealing and [[binding]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c47">''The Engineer'', chapter 47</ref> Alongside [[Spellbinder]], she was considered a legendary criminal across the galaxy.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c49">''The Engineer'', chapter 49</ref> Though she is known for her capacity to deceive, her current location remains unknown.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c51">''The Engineer'', chapter 51</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c54">''The Engineer'', chapter 54</ref> She is also credited as the creator of [[Starhammer]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c52">''The Engineer'', chapter 52</ref>}}
